title: Count tiles with no data and unusual cases
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an owner/admin (or any user with the Reports permission) on the build under test; a single workplace is selected.
  2. Seed via the app: a range with no customer sales; a window with no at-risk customers; and a "no company" invoice (create an invoice with no company attached).
custom_steps:
1. Confirm neither count tile shows a delta indicator, and the At Risk tile shows no report link.
2. With no sales in the range, confirm Sales by Customer headline shows 0; with no at-risk customers, confirm At Risk headline shows 0.
3. Confirm sales on invoices with no company are counted together as a single 'no company' customer in the Sales by Customer count.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • No count tile shows a delta indicator; the sparkline is the only comparison.
  • The At Risk Customers tile shows no report link, because there is no At Risk report.
  • If no customers had sales in the selected range, the Sales by Customer headline shows 0.
  • If no customers are at risk in the selected window, the At Risk Customers headline shows 0.
  • Sales on invoices with no company are counted together as a single "no company" customer in the Sales by Customer count.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490, story SV-9577 (S5 — Count Tiles — Sales by Customer & At Risk); Dashboard v1 specification, Confluence page 788430850, section S5; read on 2 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-N1: “No count tile shows a delta indicator; the sparkline is the only comparison.”
  • S5-N2: “The At Risk Customers tile does not show a report link, because there is no At Risk report.”
  • S5-E1: “If no customers had sales in the selected range, the Sales by Customer headline shows 0.”
  • S5-E2: “If no customers are at risk in the selected window, the At Risk Customers headline shows 0.”
  • S5-E3: “Sales made on an invoice with no company are counted together as a single "no company" customer in the Sales by Customer count.”
